text:
hana_l: Posting follow-ups from the midnight postmortem. We need concrete tests and owners so these remediations don't slip.
pranav: Paste the RCA bullets so we can map tests quickly.
hana_l: RCAs: 1) KV eviction backlog when burst hits GC window, 2) fallback model artifact mismatch (quant build tokenization), 3) cache key canonicalization dropping whitespace variants.
zoe_s: I'll own the model artifact check: deterministic pairwise eval between baseline and quant on a curated canary set.
pranav: I'll own the KV eviction test: add a `burst-gc-window` profile and a focused chaos attack to surface eviction lag.
hana_l: Proposed action items:
- KV eviction chaos + load profile (owner: pranav) — smoke in 48h, artifacts to ticket.
- Quant vs baseline deterministic eval (owner: zoe_s) — 150 prompt pairs, seed fixed, gate if token-diff > 1.0%.
- Promptcanonical unit tests + promptset (owner: hana_l) — 75 edge prompts from production traces, add to eng-ml/evals/promptsets/pm-2026-08-kv
- Post-deploy canary job (owner: zoe_s) — run model-consistency on canary and auto-rollback on gate fail.
pranav: Chaos sketch:
```
chaosctl attack kv-evict --pool=serve-main --profile=burst-gc-window --duration=20m --collect=eviction-lag,cache-miss
```
zoe_s: I'll set up a GitHub Action `eval/consistency-check` to run nightly for the first week after any model/quant changes and post JSON summaries to #eng-ml-evals.
sre-bot: Reminder: create follow-up ticket with label `incident-followup` and `tests-needed`. Link postmortem doc.
hana_l: Timeline: KV smoke by Fri (pranav), quant eval PR by Mon (zoe_s), promptset PR by Thu (hana_l), rollout guard by next Tue (zoe_s).
pranav: Also propose adding `burst-gc-window` to monthly soak matrix — we've seen this pattern twice in the last 3 months.
zoe_s: I'll make the eval seed/ordering deterministic and persist raw outputs for forensic diffs. If gate trips, GH Action will open an issue and tag `eval/regression`.
hana_l: I'll file the follow-up ticket and add the checklist. Please post a one-line update here when you hit each milestone.
pranav: Starting KV chaos smoke now, will upload traces when complete.
zoe_s: Draft PR ready by Monday morning.
sre-bot: Follow-up ticket INF-3333 created and assigned. Set due dates on owners.
hana_l: Thanks all — appreciate quick turn on these. :thumbsup:
